meta.description: A 10-item ADL-like scale. Each item is scored 0, 5, or 10 points, reflecting independence, partial assistance, or full dependence.

items.prompt:
[Eating] When you eat, what is your usual situation?
A. I can eat independently without any help
B. I sometimes need help to prepare or cut the food
C. I need someone to feed me or assist throughout the meal

[Bathing] When you take a bath or shower, what is your usual situation?
A. I can bathe independently
B. I need someone nearby to watch over me or help prepare things
C. I need full assistance from someone else

[Dressing] When you dress and undress, what is your usual situation?
A. I can do everything myself, including buttons and zippers
B. I can do most parts but sometimes need help
C. I need someone to dress or undress me

[Toileting] When you use the toilet, what is your usual situation?
A. I can use the toilet and clean myself independently
B. I need someone to support or remind me
C. I need full help or rely on diapers

[Transfers] When you get up from bed or move to a chair, what is your usual situation?
A. I can stand up, sit down, and move independently
B. I need to hold furniture or have someone lightly support me
C. I need others to use a lot of strength or almost lift me

[Indoor walking] When you walk indoors at home or inside a building, what is your usual situation?
A. I can walk indoors independently
B. I need a cane, walker, or occasional support
C. I can hardly walk indoors independently

[Stairs] When you face stairs or a short ramp, what is your usual situation?
A. I can go up and down by myself
B. I need to hold a handrail or have someone with me
C. I cannot use stairs safely

[Community mobility] When you take a bus or metro to go out, what is your usual situation?
A. I can use public transport independently on simple routes
B. I need someone to accompany me or only use very familiar routes
C. I almost never use public transport and rely on others for rides

[Medication] Regarding your daily medication, what is your usual situation?
A. I can remember and take my medicine on time by myself
B. I need reminders or a prepared pill box
C. I rely completely on others to manage and remind me

[Daily management] For tasks like simple shopping, paying bills, or remembering important appointments, what is your usual situation?
A. I can arrange and handle most of these by myself
B. I can do simple tasks, but need family help for complex ones
C. I can hardly handle these and rely on others completely
